items.name: Neodymium disc magnets, N52
items.spec: 6 mm diameter x 2 mm thick, N52, 50-pack
items.note: 4 needed (one pair per drawer) plus 2 spares; 50-pack leaves plenty for test fits. Verified listing title says 6mm x 2mm N52. Press the magnets flush with the mating faces and mind polarity.

items.name: M3 x 14 mm button-head socket cap screw
items.note: Turn-button pivot bolt. Needs a 2 mm hex key.

items.name: M3 flat washers
items.spec: M3 (3 mm ID x 9 mm OD), stainless, 100-pack
items.note: One each side of the turn button.

items.name: M3 nylon-insert lock nut (nyloc)
items.note: Tightening it sets the button friction. A thin/low-profile nyloc also works if you have one; none was verified on Amazon.

items.name: Baltic birch plywood, 1/8 in (3 mm), 12 x 24 in, B/BB, box of 12
items.note: About 6 sheets cover one box with cutting waste (3 laser layouts: 553x356, 549x433, 549x250 mm). Roughly $27 per box; the rest cover a second box.

items.name: Baltic birch plywood 1/8 in (3 mm), 5 x 5 ft sheet (cheaper alternative)
items.spec: Toledo Plywood HABA18V, BB/BB, local pickup in Ohio
items.note: One sheet cuts into roughly 12 x 24 in pieces enough for two boxes (about $8 per box). Delivery only within 80 miles of Toledo, OH. Baker Lumber (VT) lists B/BB at $29.99: https://www.bakerlumber.net/18-baltic-birch-5x5-3mm-bbb-bb0004.html. Check thickness: it varies 2.8-3.5 mm.

items.name: Wood glue
items.spec: Titebond III Ultimate Wood Glue, 8 oz
items.note: Longer open time than Titebond II, which helps with the finger-joint assembly. Apply sparingly on finger joints only.

items.name: Cyanoacrylate (CA) glue, gel
items.spec: Loctite Super Glue Ultra Gel Control, 0.14 fl oz
items.note: For setting the magnets in their holes.

items.name: Sandpaper assortment
items.spec: Dura-Gold wet/dry 5.5 x 9 in, grits 150, 220, 320, 400, 600 (25 sheets)
items.note: 150 for edges and char, 220 then 320 before finishing, 400-600 between coats and to polish drawer runners.

items.name: Paste wax for drawer runners
items.spec: Howard Wax-It-All beeswax, 9 fl oz (a plain candle stub also works)
items.note: Rub on the drawer sides, top and bottom edges and the lid rails.

items.name: Finish, wipe-on
items.spec: Minwax Oil-Based Wipe-On Polyurethane, satin, 1 pint
items.note: Apply with a lint-free rag, thin coats, 2 coats. Do not finish the sliding faces. Ventilate while it cures.

items.name: Painter's tape (to hold glue-ups)
items.spec: FrogTape Delicate Surface, 1.88 in x 60 yd
items.note: Clamps are optional; tape and rubber bands hold finger joints while the glue sets.

items.name: Paper trimmer (optional)
items.spec: Swingline ClassicCut Lite, 12 in cut, 10 sheets
items.note: Optional. Cuts letter paper into quarter sheets (4.25 x 5.5 in). Scissors and a ruler also work.

items.name: Letter paper for quarter sheets
items.spec: Hammermill Fore Multipurpose 20 lb, 8.5 x 11 in, 500 sheets
items.note: Cut each sheet into four quarter sheets (4.25 x 5.5 in). 500 sheets gives 2000 pages.

items.name: Colored pencils (recommended)
items.note: Pencils are about 7 in (178 mm). The COLORS drawer interior is 142.65 x 212.25 x 50.3 mm, so pencils lie flat lengthwise with 34 mm spare, and 24 round pencils (about 8 mm) stack under the 50 mm height. Rated 4.8 stars, about 51,500 reviews.

items.name: Colored pencils (budget alternative)
items.spec: Faber-Castell Grip Colored EcoPencils, 24 pack, pre-sharpened
items.note: Same drawer fit, about 7 in long. Rated 4.7 stars, about 676 reviews.
